name: Soft Quillbeast
desc: A beast covered in spikes all over its body, with only its belly being soft and tender.\nSoft-Shelled Hedgehogs are gentle in temperament and love to sleep. They excel at building concealed nests from grass and branches, ensuring themselves warm and cozy dreams throughout the harsh winter. If their nest is discovered, they curl into a ball, facing the world with their hard outer shell, as if this alone could ward off all threats.\nIn Snezhnayan folk tales, Soft-Shelled Hedgehogs are the cleverest of animals. They know miraculous herbal formulas, possess the secret to defying aging, and even understand how to open a lock without a key.
